evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: some of their concerns are either movers not arriving on time or damages to their items or any of this or concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'No' to concerns; Joanna acknowledged and moved to probing. No follow-up depth attempted.
evidence_quotes.value_days: we can actually save at least, you know, $80 to $100 if we're going to do it on a Sunday. So it's $20 per hour cheaper if we're going to do it on a Sunday. [Savings stated as hourly rate, not total dollar amount; flexibility was asked.]
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: would you like our help for this move on Saturday? [Asked before establishing rate lock or no-deposit commitment; customer immediately pivoted to email quote.]

top_strength: Joanna gathered detailed logistics thoroughly—floor level, walking distances at both ends, all furniture items, parking access—and confirmed box count and packing needs, painting a complete picture of the move.
coaching_note: The ask for the business came with no rate-lock or no-deposit anchor, came too early in step 5, and was immediately softened when the customer asked for an email; return to the card's sequence (pricing framing, estimate, value days, prep check) before asking, and commit to the hard ask without a built-in out.
